contract.duty: Atomic exchange owns one coalescible batch; concurrent publications remain pending; no load-then-clear and no count-from-bit inference
One strong CAS on coherent unsigned gate snapshot; failure updates expected but grants no pin/route access; bounded fallback only for admitted reason
Count saturation denies before increment; no field carry or modular generation reuse; exhausted generation seals slot
Target VM lease, handler pins, selected work and old-roster/native retirement receipts must close before VM deletion
Process-lifetime shell owns denied reasons after old VM retirement; mailbox contains no Scheme/VM pointer and survives completion of old batch
Only process-scoped coalescible native reasons with generation-invariant meaning admit this fallback; source behavior alone does not prove policy equivalence
Normal process custodian explicitly authorizes batch target under lease; unknown decision retains original lease, never auto-rebinds next VM
Bound work keeps real target VM and old roster serviceable; semantic mailbox bits are not sync-op completion

gain.avoided: Avoid unbounded CAS retry and unsafe reads after rejection
gain.added: Per admitted entry one snapshot load, one successful strong CAS and one final decrement, plus work/wake publication
gain.condition: Logical operation counts only; packing must be lock-free and all fields use the same atomic protocol

gain.avoided: Coalescible process reasons need one pending bit and one exchange per batch
gain.added: Stable native custodian, atomic fetch-or/exchange and effect reconciliation
gain.condition: Only equivalent reason effects may merge; counted payloads and policy-dependent identities require other transport

gain.avoided: Old VM may retire while denied process reasons remain safely owned
gain.added: Target lease per authorized batch; journal for unknown decision; global shell lifetime
gain.condition: Mailbox does not eliminate required roots for VM-specific payloads; no automatic new-generation target

gain.avoided: Modern C can share one generated reason/profile, gate and receipt contract
gain.added: Atomics, explicit enum outcomes and semantic refinement obligations
gain.condition: Zig cannot remove CAS, coalescing, policy or lifetime proofs; no extra language net benefit established

gate.duty: Exact unsigned representation, coherent snapshot, tag/count widths and overflow non-wrap proof
Always-lock-free signal-safe strong CAS/fetch-or/exchange on admitted target; no libatomic mutex
Per-signal coalescing and generation-invariant process intent proven observationally against Scheme callbacks
VM registry lease and policy journal atomic acceptance, unknown-result query and rollback refined
Stable code/native slots/process custodian outlive handlers and all VM cleanup; no hidden payload root
All signal/direct/embedding aliases migrated; old flag clear and signal-time VM walk cannot bypass contract
Old-roster/root/native-close/OS-join/fallback plus inherited host attestation remain unqualified
